subject: maths
question: What is that rate of simple interest at which a sum of money becomes three times of Itself in 36 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = P

Amount = 3P

Time = 36 years

**Concept used:**

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Simple interest (S.I) = Amount - Principal

⇒ S.I = 3P - P = 2P

Simple interest (S.I) = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 2P = (P × R × 36)/100

⇒ R × 36 = 200

⇒ R = 200/36 = 5.55%

**∴ The correct answer is 5.55%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Calculation:**

(R × T)/100 = (N-1)

⇒ (R × 36)/100 = (3 - 1)

⇒ R × 36 = 200

⇒ R = 200/36 = 5.55%

∴ The correct answer is 5.55%
